info.title: Cafe Interior Designer Ideas Portal
info.description: Backend API for Cafe Interior Designer Ideas Portal

post.description: Register a new Cafe Owner or Interior Designer account.
Authenticate credentials and issue JWT access token.

get.description: Search and filter design concepts with multi-select facets and pagination.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search keyword in title, description, or style
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Search keyword in title, description, or style

post.description: Publish a new design post. Requires Designer role.

get.description: Retrieve full details of a specific design post.

patch.description: Update an existing design post. Only the author or admin can update.

delete.description: Delete a design post. Only the author or admin can delete.

post.description: Request a 15-minute presigned PUT URL for direct S3 asset upload.
Confirm successful S3 upload and link asset to design post.

get.description: Retrieve details for a media asset.
Fetch project boards. If authenticated, defaults to user's boards unless public_only is set.

parameters.name: public_only

schema.description: Filter only public boards across all users
schema.title: Public Only

parameters.description: Filter only public boards across all users

post.description: Create a custom project board with private/public visibility.

get.description: Retrieve details and bookmarked concepts for a specific board.

patch.description: Update project board name, description, or visibility.

post.description: Idempotently bookmark a design post to a board.

delete.description: Remove a bookmarked design post from a project board.

post.description: Submit a consultation inquiry to a designer. Validates email or phone contact requirement.

get.description: List consultation leads received by the logged-in interior designer.
Retrieve details of a specific consultation lead.

patch.description: Update status of a consultation lead (e.g. 'new' -> 'in_review' -> 'contacted' -> 'closed').
